vibe: Premium, High-end, Cinematic, Moody, Architectural, Trustworthy

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tighter text-white

surfaces_and_effects.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/70 border-b border-white/5 sticky top-0 z-50
surfaces_and_effects.cards: bg-[#121212] border border-white/5 shadow-2xl hover:border-[#D4AF37]/30 transition-colors duration-300

layout_strategies.hero: Full height (min-h-[90vh]), dark image background with gradient overlay, massive typography aligned left or center, gold primary CTA. Minimal distraction.
layout_strategies.services: Asymmetrical Bento Grid (Tetris Mode A). Mix of tall, wide, and square cards to display the 9 BTP services dynamically. Avoid standard boring 3x3 grids.
layout_strategies.gallery: Masonry style or horizontal smooth-scroll gallery showcasing high-end architectural and construction imagery.
layout_strategies.contact: Glassmorphism form card layered over a subtle dark masonry texture background, ensuring a highly tactile, premium feel.
layout_strategies.footer: Generous spacing (py-32), dark contrasting background (e.g. #050505), large stylized E3C initials as a graphic element.

components.button: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black font-semibold tracking-wide hover:bg-[#E6C65A] px-8 py-4 rounded-none (sharp edges for architectural feel)
components.floating_whatsapp: fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 rounded-full bg-green-500 text-white p-4 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,197,94,0.4)] hover:scale-110 transition-transform
components.accordion: Shadcn accordion for FAQ. Custom styling: border-b border-white/10, text-white, plus/minus icons in gold.
components.form_input: Shadcn inputs customized to have bg-white/5 border-white/10 text-white focus:border-[#D4AF37] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] rounded-none px-4 py-6

hero.description: Wide-angle photograph of a modern luxury villa construction site at twilight golden hour. Use as main hero background with dark overlay.

background_texture.description: Abstract dark architectural background with gold accents. Great for Footer or Values section background.

masonry_texture.description: Close-up masonry texture. Use as a subtle background for the 'Zone d'intervention' or 'Contact' section.

services.description: Luxury modern bathroom interior. Perfect for Plomberie or Rénovation service card.

gallery.description: Modern house with pool at dusk
Stunning multi-storey modern building reflecting on calm waters

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a sophisticated, technical look. Colors should predominantly be the gold accent (#D4AF37) or muted gray for secondary icons.

testing.instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install necessary shadcn components: accordion, input, button, textarea, form.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body.
Follow the Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) aesthetic: Deep obsidian background, gold accents, textured images, cinematic lighting. Avoid neon or playful colors.
Build the 9 BTP services in a 'Bento Grid' layout. Use the `gallery` images inside the bento boxes or a dedicated gallery section.
Header must be sticky with a glassmorphism effect.
Ensure all backgrounds that have text overlays maintain WCAG AA contrast, specifically using 'bg-black/50' or gradients on hero images.
Add a floating WhatsApp CTA at the bottom right.
Create stylized 'E3C' text as a logo in the header and footer, using the gold accent color and a bold geometric font style.
